Alien Radio

Two neural agents invented this language from nothing. The sender sees one object and may transmit only 3 symbols from an alphabet of 8. The receiver sees five candidates in shuffled order and must point at the right one. Nothing else passes between them. 20% of colour × shape × location combinations (marked NEW) were never seen in training.

This pair, measured live in your browser

400 random rounds each. Swap the receiver for one from another seed: the senders' languages were invented independently, so a stranger mostly can't understand them.

The receiver's dictionary

Built by intervention: for every object, overwrite one message position with each of the 8 symbols and record what the receiver picks among all 128 objects. Each position is labelled with the attribute its edits change most. Each symbol is labelled with the one attribute value the receiver most reliably reads from it in that slot, whatever the other two symbols say (100% = a perfectly context-free word).
